name: Magic Missile Storm, Lesser
body:
School evocation [force]; Level bloodrager 4, magus 4, psychic 4, sorcerer/wizard 4

CASTING

Area 30 ft. radius

This spell functions as magic missile except the spell creates 1 force missile per caster level (to a maximum of 10 missiles) and each missile randomly targets enemies within the radius of the spell Also, each missile deals 1d6+1 force damage.

If there are more targets than missiles, only the closest targets to the center of the radius are affected. These force missiles are considered magic missiles for the purposes of the shield spell or other items that absorb or negate magic missiles.
